art_note: Clean digital mockups on pure white, but lacking organic texture, depth, and luxury campaign staging.
desc_en: A refined expression of contemporary minimalism. These low-top sneakers combine lightweight technical performance with clean lines, featuring an upper constructed from resilient polyurethane and breathable mesh. Anchored by an EVA outsole, the design incorporates a removable cushioned insole for day-long support. Polished metal eyelets punctuate the lace-up closure with discreet industrial precision. Engineered to seamlessly transition through urban environments. Crafted to order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Un estudio de minimalismo urbano y proporciones depuradas. Estas zapatillas de caña baja equilibran ligereza técnica y elegancia funcional mediante un corte confeccionado en poliuretano y malla transpirable. Asentadas sobre una suela ergonómica de EVA, integran una plantilla interior extraíble para asegurar confort constante a lo largo del día. Los ojales metálicos aportan un acento sobrio y estructurado. Una silueta versátil creada para elevar el calzado cotidiano. Confeccionadas bajo pedido con envío a todo el mundo.
details_en:
· Polyurethane and breathable mesh upper
· Lightweight EVA outsole
· Removable EVA insole
· Lace-up closure with 5 metal eyelets
· Machine wash with cold water; air dry
· Made to order
details_es:
· Empeine en mezcla de poliuretano y malla transpirable
